title: Eritrea Accuses Ethiopia of Using Maritime Diplomacy to 'Camouflage Its Irredentist Ambitions'
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Eritrea has accused Ethiopia of using maritime diplomacy and regional security forums to mask what it described as territorial ambitions in the Horn of Africa, escalating tensions amid renewed disagreements over Ethiopia's pursuit of Red Sea access.

title: COP32 Offers Ethiopia a Strategic Path to Green Growth and Global Influence
summary: [ENA] When world leaders, policymakers, climate negotiators, investors, and development partners gather in Addis Ababa from November 8 to 19, 2027, for the 32nd United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP32), Ethiopia will take center stage in global climate diplomacy at a defining moment for the country and the African continent.

title: Uganda and Ethiopia Deepen Cooperation On Strategic Diaspora Mobilisation, Investment, and Knowledge Transfer
summary: [Independent (Kampala)] Addis Ababa -- Ahead of the 3 rd Annual Uganda Diaspora Convention 2026, a high- level Ugandan Inter-Ministerial Presidential Benchmarking Delegation, led by the Minister of State for Finance, Planning and Economic Development (Planning), Hon. Amos Lugoloobi, held bilateral consultations yesterday, 25 November 2026, with Ambassador Lencho Bati, Director-General of the Ethiopian Diaspora Service (EDS).

title: Ethiopia Targets Dec. 18 Settlement to End Nearly Three-Year Eurobond Default
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Ethiopia has launched a formal exchange offer to restructure its defaulted $1 billion sovereign Eurobond, targeting settlement on December 18, 2026, in a move that could end nearly three years of default and pave the way for a return to international capital markets.

title: 'Stop Arming Ethiopia's Enemies' - Abiy Tells Eritrea, Says Addis Abeba Seeks Red Sea Access Through Dialogue
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has called on the Eritrean government to "stop arming" and supporting forces opposed to Ethiopia, warning that continued cooperation with what he described as Ethiopia's enemies would undermine prospects for peaceful relations between the two neighboring countries.

title: Two MPs Raise Alarm Over Civilian Killings, Displacement and Insecurity in Ethiopia During Abiy's Parliamentary Appearance
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Two Members of the House of Peoples' Representatives (HoPR) have raised concerns over escalating human rights violations, civilian killings and displacement in several parts of Ethiopia, questioning Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed about his government's response during a parliamentary session on Thursday.

title: MP Urges Permanent 'Treason Law' Targeting Ethiopians Accused of Collaborating With Egypt
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- A member of Ethiopia's House of Peoples' Representatives has urged the government to introduce a permanent legal framework criminalizing Ethiopians accused of collaborating with Egypt to undermine the country's sovereignty, amid escalating regional tensions and growing diplomatic friction over Red Sea access.

title: Sudanese Govt Rejects Ethiopia's Initiative to Host Sudanese Dialogue, Calls for Its Exclusion From Facilitation Efforts
summary: [SNA] Khartoum, (SUNA) - The Government of Sudan has categorically rejected an initiative put forward by Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed for Ethiopia to host an inclusive and open Sudanese dialogue and facilitate its proceedings, stressing that the neutrality of the host country and its respect for Sudan's sovereignty are essential conditions for accepting any role in this regard.

title: Ethiopian Investment Holding, China's Tw Holding Sign $30 Million Deal to Establish Textbook Printing Facility in Ethiopia
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Ethiopian Investment Holdings (EIH), the Ethiopian government's strategic investment arm, has signed a shareholders' agreement with China-based TW Holding Limited to establish a joint venture for a commercial textbook printing and publishing facility in Ethiopia, with an initial investment estimated at $30 million.

title: Ethiopia-Poland Ties Gaining Economic Momentum As Both Nations Eye Broader Cooperation
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia and Poland have been working to strengthen their longstanding diplomatic relations by expanding economic cooperation, with investment and tourism emerging as key areas for collaboration, Ilona Korchut, Poland's Head of Mission to Ethiopia told ENA.

title: Egypt, Sudan Agree to Prioritize Postwar Reconstruction, Reject Red Sea Militarization
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi and Sudanese Prime Minister Kamal Idris on November 24 agreed to prioritize Sudan's postwar reconstruction, strengthen bilateral economic cooperation, and reject "attempts to militarize the Red Sea" or undermine the "sovereignty of its coastal states."

title: Horn Dialogue Participants Call for Stronger Cooperation, Strategic Trust in Horn Africa
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Strengthening regional cooperation, building strategic trust, and promoting collective action are essential to addressing the multifaceted challenges facing the Horn of Africa, participants at the fifth edition of the Horn Dialogue Series emphasized.

title: Ethiopia's Returnee Support Model Emerges As Regional Benchmark, Says IOM Officer
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia is transitioning its support for citizens returning from abroad from short-term humanitarian assistance to a sustainable, government-led system integrated into existing public institutions, an International Organization for Migration (IOM) senior officer said.

title: AfCFTA Chief Commends Ethiopia's Trade Reforms, Cites Progress in Duty-Free Exports
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) Secretary-General Wamkele Keabetswe Mene commends Ethiopia's sweeping trade, logistics, and digital reforms.

title: Sudan Rejects Ethiopia's Initiative to Host Peace Talks
summary: [Dabanga] Addis Ababa / Khartoum -- The Sudanese government has rejected an initiative by Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed to host and facilitate an inclusive Sudanese dialogue aimed at ending the war, despite welcoming responses from the Sudan Founding Alliance and the Civil Democratic Alliance of Revolutionary Forces (Sumoud).

title: Moyale and the Limits of Kenya's Silence On Ethiopia
summary: [African Arguments] At the end of October, staff from UNHCR and the Kenya Red Cross began issuing coded wristbands to Ethiopian families sheltering in schools and churches in Moyale, a town in Kenya's Marsabit County that shares its name, and in practice its streets, with the Ethiopian town across the border. summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- In politics, the most consequential figure is not always the person holding public office or leading a political party. Sometimes influence belongs to an individual who stands just outside the formal structure: the broadcaster who can mobilize a crowd, the activist who can unsettle an established order, the insider who can fracture a coalition, or the political entrepreneur who thrives on keeping the landscape in perpetual motion. title: Sudan's Army-Aligned Government Rejects Abiy's Dialogue Call - RSF-Backed Administration Welcomes It
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Sudan's army-aligned government has rejected Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's invitation for an inclusive Sudanese dialogue hosted in Ethiopia, while a rival administration aligned with the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) has welcomed the initiative, highlighting divisions over Ethiopia's proposed role in efforts to end Sudan's war.

title: Ethiopia Vows Direct Role in Shaping Red Sea Security Architecture, Maritime Governance
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Red Sea security is an integral part of Ethiopia's national security, and the country will continue to play a direct and constructive role in regional maritime governance, Chief of Staff at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ambassador Adam Tesfaye, said.

title: Ethiopia Showcases Africa's Potential Through Tangible Milestones in Health Sector
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia is demonstrating Africa's capabilities and potential through tangible achievements and transformative progress in the healthcare sector, Minister of Health Dr. Mekdes Daba said.

title: Ethiopia, Pakistan Agree to Deepen Defence and Aviation Cooperation
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia and Pakistan have agreed to strengthen bilateral cooperation in defence and aviation, opening further avenues for strategic partnership between the two countries.

title: Obasanjo to Chair Sasakawa Africa Association's 40th Anniversary Symposium in Addis Ababa
summary: [Nile Post] Former Nigerian President Olusegun Obasanjo is set to chair the Sasakawa Africa Association's (SAA) 40th anniversary symposium scheduled for December 1-2, 2026, in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, bringing together African leaders, policymakers, agricultural experts and development partners to discuss the future of the continent's food and nutrition security.

title: Somalia's Parliament Speaker Accuses Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda of Colluding With Al-Shabaab
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Somalia's parliamentary speaker Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur, also known as Jaamac, has accused Kenya, Ethiopia and Uganda of colluding with Al-Shabaab, alleging that Israel had brought together the three countries, the militant group and forces loyal to former South West State leader Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen in a coordinated front against the federal government.

title: Ethiopia Intensifies Efforts to Expand Earning From Pulses and Oilseeds, Sector Contributes $572.9 Million
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia, which has earned about 5 percent of the country's total export from pulses and oilseeds last Ethiopian fiscal year, is stepping up efforts to expand the earning through economic reforms, investment promotion, improved product quality and value addition, Trade and Regional Integration Minister Yasmin Wohabrebbi said.

title: Arkwood Africa Film Market and Awards Forum to Take Place in Addis Ababa
summary: [ENA] The second edition of Arkwood Africa Film Market and Awards will be held at Adwa Victory Memorial Museum in Addis Ababa from November 27-28, 2026, according to Ministry of Culture and Tourism.

title: PM Abiy Invites All Sudanese Parties to Inclusive Dialogue, Offers Ethiopia As Host for Peace Talks
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has extended an open invitation to all Sudanese military, political and civilian parties to participate in an inclusive national dialogue hosted and facilitated by Ethiopia, calling for an end to the devastating war and a Sudanese-led path toward lasting peace.

title: Strategic Location Qualifies Ethiopia to Invigorate Trade Connectivity in Continent - Egyptian Comesa Expert
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- An Egyptian expert at the Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa (COMESA) has described Ethiopia as a "Land of Origin," highlighting its strategic location as a vital link between markets in Eastern, Western and Central Africa.

title: PM Abiy to Address Parliament On Government Performance, National Priorities Thursday
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed is set to appear at the House of Peoples' Representatives on Thursday to present the federal government's performance during the 2026/27 Ethiopian fiscal year's quarter and respond to lawmakers' questions on key national issues.

title: Ethiopia Launches Polio Vaccination Campaign Targeting 11.3 Million Children
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Ethiopia has launched a polio vaccination campaign targeting more than 11.3 million children across five regions, amid continued outbreaks of circulating variant poliovirus that threaten children in areas with gaps in immunization coverage.
